interpretation: A retained final pose can include IMU-only coasting; pose coverage is not visual success.

Visual OK without final export can mean either largest-only suppression or a later cleared map; legacy outputs cannot disambiguate.
Online snapshots preserve estimates before reset, but do not retrospectively follow optimization and may change gauge at world_version updates.

protocol_notes: One CP-derived Sim3; no separate dense-GT fit.

Missing input poses remain absent; no gap filling or independent-map stitching.
Local per-sequence score, not a leaderboard submission.

recovery_interpretation.diagnostic_caveat: bow_cam0/1 count updates only after candidate total >=15, so zero logs mean below that gate, not necessarily zero raw matches.
recovery_interpretation.two_lenses: Separate >=10-match per-camera MLPnP hypotheses; cam1 converted with Tlr; subsequent rig pose optimizer verifies both cameras; not a generalized multi-camera ray solver.
recovery_interpretation.descriptor_path: Binarized ALIKED descriptors feed stock ORB vocabulary; SearchByBoW restricts comparisons to shared vocabulary nodes. Domain mismatch is a source-backed suspect, not controlled proof.
recovery_interpretation.minimal_candidate: Bypass ORB vocabulary partition for recovery matching using native ALIKED float descriptors for current/pre-dropout keyframes; retain geometric verification and acceptance thresholds, full rollback, and frozen80.20 baseline.

loop_closure.candidate_counts: Not logged; cannot infer zero retrieval candidates.
loop_closure.source: LoopClosing.cc346 waits for inertial BA2;496 retrieves top3 ORB-BoW candidates;177/197/234 print accepted merge/loop markers absent from both logs.

calibration_guard.finding: More than one populated map disables the entire periodic FullCalibrationBA, including full-map VI refinement, not only intrinsics. Ordinary local BA continues. Shared camera objects require this guard for present single-map graph.
calibration_guard.proposal: Split fixed-intrinsic periodic full VI refinement from calibration commits. Keep shared intrinsics frozen across independent maps until safe all-map atomic calibration or per-map versioning exists; do not simply remove guard.
